Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_008905.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Read input: origen_008905.v · Open raw
module origen_008905 (
    input wire CLK,
    input wire CLK_10U,
    input wire RESET,
    input wire CS,
    input wire IR,
    output reg READY,
    output reg [15:0] DO
);

    // State definitions
    localparam IDLE = 3'd0;
    localparam LEADER_CODE = 3'd1;
    localparam DATA_RECEPTION = 3'd2;
    localparam DATA_VALIDATION = 3'd3;
    localparam ERROR = 3'd6;
    localparam COOL_DOWN = 3'd7;

    reg [2:0] state, next_state;
    reg [13:0] time_out;
    reg [31:0] shift_reg;
    reg [5:0] bit_count;
    reg ir_prev, ir_edge;
    reg [15:0] data_out;

    // Edge detection
    always @(posedge CLK or posedge RESET) begin
        if (RESET)
            ir_prev <= 1'b1;
        else
            ir_prev <= IR;
    end

    assign ir_edge = ir_prev & ~IR;

    // State machine and main logic
    always @(posedge CLK or posedge RESET) begin
        if (RESET) begin
            state <= IDLE;
            time_out <= 14'd0;
            shift_reg <= 32'd0;
            bit_count <= 6'd0;
            READY <= 1'b0;
            DO <= 16'd0;
        end else begin
            state <= next_state;

            if (CLK_10U)
                time_out <= (ir_edge) ? 14'd0 : time_out + 14'd1;

            case (state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if (ir_edge) begin
                        time_out <= 14'd0;
                        shift_reg <= 32'd0;
                        bit_count <= 6'd0;
                    end
                end

                LEADER_CODE: begin
                    if (ir_edge && (time_out >= 14'd420 && time_out <= 14'd460)) begin
                        time_out <= 14'd0;
                    end
                end

                DATA_RECEPTION: begin
                    if (ir_edge) begin
                        shift_reg <= {shift_reg[30:0], (time_out > 14'd60) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0};
                        bit_count <= bit_count + 6'd1;
                        time_out <= 14'd0;
                    end
                end

                DATA_VALIDATION: begin
                    if ((shift_reg[7:0] == ~shift_reg[15:8]) && (shift_reg[23:16] == ~shift_reg[31:24])) begin
                        data_out <= {shift_reg[23:16], shift_reg[7:0]};
                        READY <= 1'b1;
                        DO <= {shift_reg[23:16], shift_reg[7:0]};
                    end
                end

                ERROR, COOL_DOWN: begin
                    // Do nothing, wait for timeout
                end
            endcase

            if (CS)
                READY <= 1'b0;
        end
    end

    // Next state logic
    always @(*) begin
        next_state = state;
        case (state)
            IDLE:
                if (ir_edge) next_state = LEADER_CODE;

            LEADER_CODE:
                if (time_out > 14'd460) next_state = ERROR;
                else if (ir_edge && (time_out >= 14'd420 && time_out <= 14'd460)) next_state = DATA_RECEPTION;

            DATA_RECEPTION:
                if (time_out > 14'd120) next_state = ERROR;
                else if (bit_count == 6'd32) next_state = DATA_VALIDATION;

            DATA_VALIDATION:
                next_state = COOL_DOWN;

            ERROR:
                if (time_out >= 14'd1000) next_state = IDLE;

            COOL_DOWN:
                if (time_out >= 14'd1000) next_state = IDLE;

            default:
                next_state = IDLE;
        endcase
    end

endmodule
